integrity: The exact symbolic and rational-interval tests reproduce the polynomial and sign certificates; the written proof supplies the infinite-parameter inference. General Hessian identity and original critical family are credited to the cited authors.
scientific_limitations: Local two-parameter projective deformation modulo affine changes for nondegenerate critical pentagons only. At the two transition parameters higher-order behavior is unresolved. Later revisions and unindexed literature remain bibliographic risks.
title: Two exact Morse transitions along the self-polar critical-pentagon curve
